Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.support

Class IoStringBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.support.IoStringBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Appendable
public final class IoStringBuilder extends Object implements Appendable
A high-performance, auto-resizing Appendable designed for zero-allocation intermediate text buffering. Unlike StringBuilder, this class avoids internal String copies when appending to a Writer.

Note: This class is not thread-safe!

      public IoStringBuilder()
      Constructs a new IoStringBuilder with a default initial capacity.

      This constructor initializes the underlying CharBuffer to the default minimum capacity defined by MIN_CAPACITY.

    • IoStringBuilder

      public IoStringBuilder(int initialCapacity)
      Constructs a new IoStringBuilder with the specified initial capacity.
      Parameters:
      initialCapacity - the initial capacity of the underlying CharBuffer to allocate for the string builder. Must be a non-negative value.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified initialCapacity is negative

      public void writeTo(Writer writer) throws IOException
      Writes the content of the internal buffer to the specified Writer.

      Note: After writing, the buffer is cleared for reuse.

      Parameters:
      writer - the Writer to which the contents of the buffer will be written
      Throws:

      public void reset()
      Clears this instance for reuse.

    • reset

      public void reset(int maxCapacity)
      Clears this instance for reuse.

      The internal buffer will be trimmed if the capacity exceeds the provided maxCapacity.

      Parameters:
      maxCapacity - the maximum capacity to retain; if the current buffer capacity exceeds this value, a new buffer with the specified maximum capacity will be allocated
